title: Chat: fixed assistant replies drawing twice

set.now: root cause found: ux/Dictate/chat.js's attach() wires up BOTH Session.watch() (file polling) and Session.stream() (SSE) to the same draw() callback. Session.js's own doc comment confirms stream's 'line' events are meant to arrive before the next poll tick, so watch() is expected to later redeliver the exact same line from the file — by design, both channels carry every real line, but nothing dedupes between them. own_ats only catches the owner's OWN echoed sends, never an assistant reply, so every assistant line (fast and smart) gets drawn twice — exactly 'four messages total' for two real replies.
set.outcome:
**Fixed: every assistant reply drew twice in the chat.** [`ux/Dictate/chat.js`](http://monorepo.localhost/framework/ux/Dictate/) listens for new lines two ways at once (an SSE push and a file poll) and only the owner's own echoed message was ever deduped against that — so each assistant's reply became two bubbles, four messages for two real replies.

- [x] found why — both channels deliver every real line by design; the dedup only ever covered the owner's own send, never a reply
- [x] fixed at the root, in the one shared chat every surface uses (✦ sheet, drawer, cards, this page's own demo): [chat.js](http://monorepo.localhost/framework/ux/Dictate/chat.js), docs updated at [doc/chat.md](http://monorepo.localhost/framework/ux/Dictate/doc/chat/)
- [ ] proved it live — blocked: this session's `node` and every site/MCP tool call returned 'requires approval' with no approver reachable (confirmed on a fresh subagent too); verified instead by a full manual read of the diff and a repo-wide grep confirming no other live surface shares the bug
